**Yaroslav says:** Focus on the matmul above everything else; there's no usage limit or deadline, so use all the cards without restriction, all night.

**Claude says:** The NDA box's seventh matmul sweep runs E136's rgm136 unchanged (kernel ELF sha256 aace138caf8071cc7679134211045a89fb09b65cc9a170bfe33409fd36b4fda0) over 299 gemmL arms of the lab's kinds and an anchor in nine sessions (839 runs, about 517 planned card-minutes, no designed tiles): a blind test of the frozen v3.7 (frozen Fri 19:12 PST, refitted on E221, E220 and E218) where its new terms act and its open questions lie, the core-group placement law first with 512 held-out placements in 15 sets, then the held-walk edge, the L3 region, the wide-B wait and the masked energy terms, with its forecast from the frozen v3.7 sealed before any datum: sha256 eb5478f65e509cf28e1c46bb55da5a30cc757beab54ba9db7cebeee6465af4ee. On aifoundry1, one session at a time: card 1 S1-S3 at 600 MHz, every run planned at or under 66.6 W (the card's planning line 70 W), the stop at 75 W; card 0 S1-S3 low power, every arm planned at or under 52 W, a live stop at 65 W; -j1 builds, no session at a host load of 6 or more; the kit (the sixth sweep's with its name changed) goes to `~/claude/work/ee-1121-mmsweep7/src/` on each box and is built and dry-run there before any claim. aifoundry2 card 0's three sessions, every run planned at or under 66.6 W and none in the time role, ask to run under the sixth sweep's live stops (board above 85 W on 3 samples, die 80 C, as accepted in #15 on Fri 05:54; E216's 70 W read between sessions). May we take both boxes from E224's release? Each push, claim and release follows as a reply here.
